generated_warm_tcl:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
set_multi_cpu_usage -local_cpu 1
set_db init_design_uniquify false
read_mmmc $out/canary_mmmc.tcl
read_physical -lefs [list \
 $root/.cache/physical/routing_kit/N28_PRTF_Cad_v1d5a/PR_tech/Cadence/LefHeader/VHV/tsmcn28_10lm5X2Y2ZUTRDL.tlef \
 $root/.cache/physical/library/tcbn28hpcplusbwp12t40p140.lef]
read_netlist $out/canary.v -top unique215_canary_top
init_design
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_design242_metadata.tcl
set_db [get_db current_design] .dont_touch true
tri242_design_snapshot $out/source_design.tsv
write_db $out/source.db
puts TRI243_INHERITED_DESIGN_REFERENCE_SAVED
exit
generated_cold_tcl:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
read_db $out/source.db
set_multi_cpu_usage -local_cpu 1
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_unique215_snapshot.tcl
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_design242_metadata.tcl
tri242_require_design $out/source_design.tsv $out/cold_design.tsv
tri215_snapshot $out before_fault
set_db [get_db current_design] .dont_touch none
tri215_snapshot $out after_fault
if {![catch {tri242_require_design $out/source_design.tsv $out/fault_design.tsv} reason] || $reason ne "TRI242_DESIGN_PRESERVATION_CHANGED"} {error TRI243_DESIGN_FLAG_LOSS_NOT_REJECTED}
puts "TRI243_DESIGN_FLAG_LOSS_REJECTED $reason"
tri242_restore_design $out/source_design.tsv
tri242_require_design $out/source_design.tsv $out/restored_design.tsv
foreach {name expected} {wrong TRI242_WRONG_DESIGN_METADATA_TARGET duplicate TRI242_BAD_DESIGN_LEDGER unsupported TRI242_UNSUPPORTED_DESIGN_FLAG} {
    if {![catch {tri242_restore_design $out/$name.tsv} reason] || $reason ne $expected} {error "TRI243_BAD_LEDGER_NOT_REJECTED $name $reason"}
    puts "TRI243_BAD_LEDGER_REJECTED $name $reason"
}
tri242_require_design $out/source_design.tsv $out/final_design.tsv
puts TRI243_DESIGN_INHERITANCE_CONTROL_PASSED
exit

generated_sources.canary_mmmc.tcl:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
create_library_set -name tiny -timing [list $root/.cache/physical/library/tcbn28hpcplusbwp12t40p140tt1v25c.lib]
create_rc_corner -name rc -temperature 25
create_timing_condition -name tc -library_sets {tiny}
create_delay_corner -name dc -timing_condition tc -rc_corner rc
create_constraint_mode -name functional -sdc_files [list $out/canary.sdc]
create_analysis_view -name view -constraint_mode functional -delay_corner dc
set_analysis_view -setup {view} -hold {view}
